items.a: Formely AI drafts course structures, lessons and test questions based on your brief and materials. Configure the topic, level and other details in the form before generating.

items.q: Can I use my existing procedures?
items.a: Yes. Add PDFs or study text to give the generation context. Formely AI drafts the content, and you check that explanations and questions reflect your company’s materials.
You decide when to publish. Review generated explanations, examples and test answers. You can edit the content before assigning it to your team.

items.q: Is Formely AI included in the subscription?
items.a: Course and test generation is included in every plan. Instructor has 100 AI credits per month, Academie 500 and Business 2500. A course uses 15 credits and a test 3. Additional features differ by plan.

items.q: How do I start the trial?
items.a: Send an access request. We email you within 24h to arrange activation and help you start your first course. You have 14 free days after activation.

items.q: How does my team access the courses?
items.a: Invite employees by email. They access courses and tests in a browser, on their phone or computer. You track progress and results in the platform.

legal.privacyIntro: This page explains what personal data the public Formely website collects and why. It covers the contact form and visits to the site, not learner data inside an academy that is already active.
legal.controller: The controller of this website is Formely. For requests about your data:
legal.cookieBody: We only store your language choice in your browser. This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies.

privacySections.title: What this covers
paragraphs: This policy applies to the Formely marketing site: public pages and the “Get started” form.

When an organization uses the platform, that organization is the controller for learner and staff data. Formely processes that data as a processor, under the contract with the organization. That processing is not described here.

privacySections.title: What we collect on the site
paragraphs: From the form: name, email, phone, organization, and plan of interest.
We also store the time of consent and the IP address, so we can show the request was sent voluntarily and to limit abuse.
The server may keep short technical logs: IP address, browser type, page, and time, for security.
Your language choice stays in the browser (localStorage). We do not send it to the server.

privacySections.title: What we do not do
paragraphs: We do not place third-party marketing or analytics cookies on this site. We do not sell the data, sending the form does not create a public account, and we do not make automated decisions about you based on this website.

privacySections.title: Why we use it
paragraphs: To answer an activation request: your consent and steps before a contract.
To protect the site from abuse: legitimate interest (security).
To remember the language: so the site stays in the language you chose.

privacySections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Contact requests: up to 24 months after the last exchange, sooner if you ask us to delete them, or until they become part of a contract.
Security logs: up to 90 days.
Browser language: until you change it or clear site data.
Visit statistics (page, source, device, language and a daily code, without the IP): we keep them to see where requests come from. The code cannot identify you the next day.

privacySections.title: Who receives it
paragraphs: The Formely team handling requests, the email provider (if internal notification is on), and the hosting provider. We do not send it to ad networks.

privacySections.title: Where it is stored
paragraphs: We aim to store data in the European Economic Area. If a provider processes data outside the EEA, we use safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.

privacySections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, or a copy of the data. You can withdraw consent at any time. That does not undo processing already done.
Email or call us using the details above. You can also complain to the ANSPDCP (Romania), the National Center for Personal Data Protection (Moldova), or the supervisory authority in your country.

privacySections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We do not set tracking cookies. We store the chosen language locally so we do not ask on every visit. If you arrived from an ad, we keep the link parameters (such as the campaign name) until you close the tab, so we know where your request came from if you send the form. You can clear this data in your browser settings. We count visits on our own server: the page, the source, the language and the device type. From the IP address and the browser we calculate a code that changes every day; the IP is not stored in that statistic. Separate security logs may contain the IP for up to 90 days.

privacySections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If we change this policy, we update the date on this page. Requests already sent follow the version in force at that time, plus the rights the law gives you anyway.

legal.termsIntro: These terms apply to the public Formely website. The platform contract is signed separately, after the offer is confirmed.

termsSections.title: What the site is
paragraphs: The pages describe the product. They are not a firm price offer and they do not by themselves open a service contract.

termsSections.title: Access to the platform
paragraphs: Accounts are created after the offer is confirmed, by invitation. Use of an academy is governed by the contract with the organization, not by these pages.

termsSections.title: Contact form
paragraphs: The information must be accurate. Do not send other people’s data without a lawful basis. Processing is described in the privacy policy.

termsSections.title: Content
paragraphs: Formely text, brand, and interface are protected. Short quotation with attribution is fine. Do not copy the site for a competing product.

termsSections.title: Availability
paragraphs: The site may be interrupted for maintenance. Commercial descriptions can change.

termsSections.title: Liability
paragraphs: For use of the public site, liability is limited to foreseeable direct damage, to the extent the law allows. We do not exclude liability that cannot legally be excluded.

termsSections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: Romanian law applies. This does not limit your right to contact a supervisory authority in your EU country.
